description: CFG-204: legacy TLS chain — first set of SSL_CERT_FILE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE wins; none set falls back to system CAs

expect.note: Import-time shim copies REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE into SSL_CERT_FILE when the first two are unset.

note: Python behavior as of 2026-09-03 (get_ssl_verify, lru_cached). go/rust configure TLS per-client in code and do not read these keys (n/a).
resolved_key_note: The resolved key `tls.verify` is NOT a registry logical key — it is the httpx `verify` output that the legacy chain produces (a path string when a CA bundle is selected, or boolean true for system CAs). The registry logical keys this case reads from are `tls.cert_file` (SSL_CERT_FILE), `tls.ca_bundle` (CURL_CA_BUNDLE), and `tls.ca_bundle_requests` (REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE); a runner MUST map to those, not to `tls.verify`.
